The policy sets a flat meals per‑diem of **$45 USD per day** for any business travel.  

For a 3‑day domestic trip you would apply that rate for each day:

\[
3 \text{ days} \times \$45/\text{day} = \$135 \text{ total}
\]

So the per‑diem amount to claim for meals on the 3‑day trip is **$135 USD**. (No receipts are required for this per‑diem.)
